messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a list of the **long‑weekend holidays** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
A long weekend is defined as a public holiday that falls on a Friday, Saturday, or Sunday, giving you at least two consecutive days off (plus the weekend).

| Date | Holiday | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span |
|------|---------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Jan 1 2023** | New Year’s Day | Sunday | Jan 1–2 (Sunday–Monday) |
| **Feb 20 2023** | Family Day (BC, AB, ON, NB, PE) | Monday | Feb 20–21 (Monday–Tuesday) |
| **May 22 2023** | Victoria Day | Monday | May 22–23 (Monday–Tuesday) |
| **Jul 1 2023** | Canada Day | Saturday | Jul 1–3 (Saturday–Monday) |
| **Sep 4 2023** | Labour Day | Monday | Sep 4–5 (Monday–Tuesday) |
| **Oct 9 2023** | Thanksgiving | Monday | Oct 9–10 (Monday–Tuesday) |
| **Dec 25 2023** | Christmas Day | Monday | Dec 25–26 (Monday–Tuesday) |

> **Note:**  
> * Family Day is observed in several provinces (BC, AB, ON, NB, PE) but not nationwide.  
> * Some provinces have additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. George’s Day in British Columbia) that may create extra long weekends for residents of those provinces.  
> * The table above lists the holidays that create a long weekend for the majority of Canadians.

Feel free to integrate this list into your holiday‑planning app! If you need province‑specific long weekends or additional details, let me know.
